final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by matching each log entry's start line with a regex to extract the timestamp, service, level, and message. I filtered entries to include only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. For each entry, I calculated the repeat_count by adding 1 plus any repeats indicated by following lines. I aggregated counts by service from the repeat counts. Finally, I wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure, ensuring compliance with Acme log-triage conventions.
